remarks: Nestled in the heart of Norwalk, this pristine, move-in-ready unit in the sought-after Phoenix on Isaac complex is an incredible opportunity to live in the vibrant city of Norwalk. Natural sunlight floods the open living and dining area, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The updated kitchen is fully equipped with gleaming granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and beautifully crafted cabinetry. A versatile bonus room-perfect as a den, office, nursery, or guest space-features a half bath and sliders leading to a private balcony, adding valuable flexibility to the layout.  The spacious bedroom offers a generous walk-in closet and an adjacent full bath, while additional conveniences include an in-unit washer/dryer and a reserved parking space in the secure garage.  The well-maintained complex features a full fitness center, an elevator, and ample visitor parking. Enjoy unbeatable proximity to the Norwalk Music & Arts District, local restaurants and shops, Norwalk Hospital, Mathews Park/Stepping Stones Museum, and the Norwalk Library. Plus, it's just a short drive to I-95, the Route 7 Connector, SONO's vibrant attractions and nightlife, the South and East Norwalk train stations, and The SONO Collection mall.  Move-in fee: $100.
